text:
sam: Noticed billing mismatch for multi-tenant micro-batches. A batch with 3 tenants was fully charged to one account.

anya: I have two support tickets for this. Customers see higher per-call cost when our scheduler packs lots of small requests.

mikko: runtime detail: we coalesce by model+quant+seq_bucket. We only emit batch_size and token_total today. No per-tenant breakdown.

sam: proposal: add optional `batch.attribution_summary` as a tiny array of {billing_key, tokens}. Keep it capped and numeric-only.

anya: ingestion can expand that into per-tenant metrics; avoids storing per-request payloads.

mikko: runtime must support feature flag `emit_attrib_summary` and privacy mode where billing_key is hashed. Cap array at 64 entries, set `batch.truncated=true` if overflow.

ops-bot: /deploy runtime v2 --feature=emit_attrib_summary --canary=2% scheduled 2025-06-20T04:00Z

sam: next: Anya will draft a short RFC w/ schema, privacy, fallback (proportional split), retention, and alerting for sum != token_total. Mikko will prototype emitter.

anya: will draft RFC, including example payload and ingest pseudocode.
